name: review_pull_request_diff
description: Reviews a pull request diff and provides structured feedback on security, code structure, and documentation.
prompt_template: Review the following pull request diff and provide structured feedback, identifying security vulnerabilities, evaluating improvements in code structure and type hints, and suggesting documentation and error handling: {{pull_request_diff}}
input_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"pull_request_diff": {"type": "string", "description": "The code changes in the pull request."}}, "required": ["pull_request_diff"]}
examples:
[{"input": {"pull_request_diff": "diff --git a/example.py b/example.py
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
-def old_function(param):
-    return param
+def new_function(param: str) -> str:
+    return param + ' updated'"}, "expected_output": "Feedback: 1. Security: No vulnerabilities detected. 2. Code Structure: Improved type hints enhance readability. 3. Documentation: Consider adding docstrings for clarity.", "description": "Basic review of a function update."}, {"input": {"pull_request_diff": "diff --git a/security.py b/security.py
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
-def insecure_function(user_input):
-    query = 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ' + user_input
+def secure_function(user_input: str):
+    query = 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = %s' % user_input"}, "expected_output": "Feedback: 1. Security: SQL injection vulnerability fixed. 2. Code Structure: Good use of parameterized queries. 3. Documentation: Add error handling for database queries.", "description": "Review focusing on security improvements."}]

name: draft_weekly_status_email
description: Drafts a formal weekly status email from provided bullet points.
prompt_template: Draft a formal weekly status email addressed to {{manager_name}} for the week of {{week_date}}. Include the following key accomplishments and updates: {{bullet_points}}. Also, include a section for blockers, even if none exist. Sign the email with {{your_name}}.
input_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"bullet_points": {"type": "string", "description": "Key accomplishments and updates to include in the email."}, "week_date": {"type": "string", "description": "The week date to reference in the email subject."}, "manager_name": {"type": "string", "description": "The name of the manager to whom the email is addressed."}, "your_name": {"type": "string", "description": "The name of the sender of the email."}}, "required": ["bullet_points", "week_date", "manager_name", "your_name"]}
examples: [{"input": {"bullet_points": "finished auth module, fixed 3 bugs in payment flow, unblocked the mobile team on the API spec.", "week_date": "September 14, 2026", "manager_name": "John Doe", "your_name": "Jane Smith"}, "expected_output": "A formal email summarizing the accomplishments and blockers for the week of September 14, 2026, addressed to John Doe and signed by Jane Smith.", "description": "Example with multiple accomplishments."}, {"input": {"bullet_points": "completed user testing, prepared presentation for stakeholders.", "week_date": "October 21, 2026", "manager_name": "Alice Johnson", "your_name": "Bob Brown"}, "expected_output": "A formal email summarizing the accomplishments and blockers for the week of October 21, 2026, addressed to Alice Johnson and signed by Bob Brown.", "description": "Example with fewer accomplishments."}]
